content.name: Priya Sandhu
content.title: Administrative Assistant
content.summary: Organized administrative assistant with a SAIT business administration diploma and two years of office experience in a busy physiotherapy clinic and a property management firm. Comfortable with Microsoft 365, Yardi and high call volumes, and recently helped cut late rent notices by a quarter.

experience.title: Clinic Office Assistant (part-time)
bullets: Answered the clinic's main line and booked about 40 appointments per shift while finishing my diploma.
Confirmed Alberta Blue Cross and WCB coverage before visits, reducing rejected direct billings for the two therapists I supported.
Kept the waiting room and front counter organized and restocked, and handled cheque and debit payments accurately.

experience.title: Administrative Assistant
bullets: Support three property managers responsible for 420 rental units, logging maintenance tickets and tenant requests in Yardi.
Built a rent-reminder email schedule that cut late payment notices by about 25% within six months.
Prepare move-in and move-out packages, key logs and inspection forms for roughly 30 tenancies a month.
Reconcile petty cash and courier invoices each month and file them for the bookkeeper by the 5th.
